description: This Java source file defines the LogFragment class, a fragment that contains a LogView and manages log display within an Android application.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays logs using a LogView inside a ScrollView, with functionality to auto-scroll on new log entries.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, styles, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, sets up a TextWatcher to auto-scroll when log text changes.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used within the fragment.
